name: Confocal Raman determination of methane large/small cage occupancy in recovered hydrate on a Linkam THMS600 stage at 113 +/- 0.1 K
plain_name: Count methane molecules trapped in ice cages with laser light at 113 K
description: Recovered methane hydrate, stored under liquid nitrogen, is placed on a Linkam THMS600 cooling stage and measured at 113 +/- 0.1 K with a LabRAM HR800 (488 nm, 50x long-working-distance objective); the C-H stretching band splits at about 2901 and 2913 cm-1 into large- and small-cage contributions.
keywords: Count methane molecules trapped in ice cages with laser light at 113 K

sources.citation: Qin, Hartmann and Kuhs, Cage occupancies of methane hydrates: results from synchrotron X-ray diffraction and Raman spectroscopy, Proc. 8th Int. Conf. on Gas Hydrates (ICGH8-2014), Beijing (arXiv:1803.02244)

requirements.rationale: Spectra are taken with the hydrate held at 113 K so it does not decompose.
The laser is focused through a 50x long-working-distance objective onto the sample and collected in backscattering.
Samples are ground, sieved and stored under liquid nitrogen before measurement.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
